name: 2D Mask Refinement
definition: Refining preliminary instance segmentation results using CascadePSP to alleviate missing or erroneous masks caused by partial occlusion.
summary: 2D Mask Refinement improves instance segmentation by refining preliminary Instance-NeRF rendered masks with CascadePSP, leveraging multi-view fusion to resolve conflicting or missing predictions across different views.
